n,h=map(int,input().split())
episodes=run=longest=0
for _ in range(n):
    x=int(input())
    if x<h:
        if run==0: episodes+=1
        run+=1
        longest=max(longest,run)
    else: run=0
print(episodes,longest)

review-3-c1:
n=int(input())
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
gain=drops=0
for i in range(1,n):
    d=a[i]-a[i-1]
    if d>0: gain+=d
    elif d<0: drops+=1
print(gain,drops)
review-3-c3:
n=int(input())
stock={}
rejected=0
for _ in range(n):
    name,d=input().split()
    d=int(d)
    value=stock.get(name,0)+d
    if value<0: rejected+=1
    else: stock[name]=value
q=input()
print(stock.get(q,0),rejected)
